newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newfield started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newfield started as buy.

text.p: UBS Securities said it started coverage of Newfield Exploration with a buy rating.
-- Estimates 1997 earnings at $0.95 per share, 1998 earnings at $1.00 per share.
-- Cited Newfield's strong management and growth potential.
-- Set target price of $24.50 per share, based on multiple of 6.5 times 1997 cash flow estimate of $3.75 per share.

-- Said major risk for investing in Newfield is that its drilling program will not meet expectations. Said Newfield plans to drill 15-16 exploratory wells in 1997, and "an unlucky string of dry holes could leave Newfield scrambling to offset its steep production decline."
